integrity: The proof derives exact round colors from clipped distances to equal-colored degree-three endpoints and separately analyzes within-thread and cross-thread stabilization. A standalone checker recomputes the formula and orbit criterion on a broad finite grid.
scientific limitations: Only equal-cycle dumbbell graphs are classified.
The finite checker covers m<=30 and k<=100; the infinite result rests on the clipped-distance proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth and orbit recovery on equal-cycle dumbbell graphs
